title: Monaco & the Alps
introTitle: From the Mediterranean to the Alps.
intro: The next chapter of The Long Way Around begins with a drive southwest from Brescia to the Mediterranean and the tiny Principality of Monaco. After a brief stop in Monte Carlo, the route turns north through the mountains toward the Aosta Valley, finishing the day beneath Mont Blanc in Courmayeur.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave Brescia and begin the long drive toward the Mediterranean coast.

stops.name: Monte Carlo — Monaco
stops.description: Make a brief stop in Monaco and take in the heart of Monte Carlo before continuing toward the Alps.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.description: Leave the Mediterranean behind and settle in beneath Mont Blanc in the Italian Alps.
